quest.title: Food Matters
quest.description: Lyylikki, who is in charge of food distribution, seems to be in some trouble...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I'll go gather some for you.

dialogues.speaker: Lyylikki
dialogues.text: You... you want to help?! Thank you so much! Really, thank you! Then... please bring me five <color=#00E1FFFF>Lakkaberries</color>, that should be just enough!

dialogues.speaker: Lyylikki
dialogues.text: Once you bring them back, I promise I'll make you the tastiest Feast of the Moon you've ever had!

dialogues.speaker: Lyylikki
dialogues.text: These will be enough. Thank you, thank you so much! Just a moment — I'll prepare the most delicious Feast of the Moon you've ever seen!

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: Lyylikki rushes to the kitchen and throws herself into preparing the Feast of the Moon...

dialogues.speaker: Lyylikki
dialogues.text: It's ready. Please, have a taste.

dialogues.speaker: Lyylikki
dialogues.text: Thank you again for your help. Should you get hungry next time, please feel free to come by. I'll prepare a special portion just for you.

dialogues.speaker: Lyylikki

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen

dialogues.speaker: Lyylikki

dialogues.speaker: Lyylikki
dialogues.text: Thank you again for your help. Should you get hungry next time, please feel free to come by. I'll prepare a special portion just for you.

dialogues.speaker: Lyylikki
dialogues.text: Ugh... I should have brought more Lakkaberries...

response.speaker: Lyylikki
response.text: #Hello, {NICKNAME}, are you here for a Feast of the Moon? I'm so sorry, but... you might have to wait a little while.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: What is a Feast of the Moon?

response.speaker: Lyylikki
response.text: Huh? Didn't you get one last time...? Oh, right, Lady Lauma organized that one... and I guess she didn't mention the meal's official name.

response.speaker: Lyylikki
response.text: Simply put, a Feast of the Moon is a free meal we Frostmoon Scions distribute to those in need.

response.speaker: Lyylikki
response.text: Helping such people has ever been one of our traditions, though it used to be limited to the area around Hiisi Island...

response.speaker: Lyylikki
response.text: But under Lady Lauma's leadership and with everyone's help, we've gradually expanded our reach.

response.speaker: Lyylikki
response.text: Lady Lauma says this is part of spreading the Moon Goddess's Favor to all. There's a saying that goes... Um...

response.speaker: Lyylikki
response.text: "The first fruit of the harvest must be placed upon the Moonlight Altar — not as an offering to the gods, but as a spark for..."

response.speaker: Lyylikki
response.text: "A spark for..." Umm... What was the rest of it again...

response.speaker: Lyylikki
response.text: *Ahem*, anyway! This shop is one of the main distribution points for the meal. Hehe, and I manage almost everything here by myself! Pretty impressive, right?

response.speaker: Lyylikki
response.text: We've had a lot of trouble getting the meals out in Nasha Town, but I believe in what Lady Lauma says — we really can help more people this way!

response.speaker: Lyylikki
response.text: However... when I was preparing the ingredients yesterday, I forgot to close the box lid tightly, and when I woke up this morning, many fruits had been pecked open by birds and were completely unusable.

response.speaker: Lyylikki
response.text: I can barely make any Feasts of the Moon with the remaining Lakkaberries... *sigh*... What should I do now...

choices.text: (It seems they were handing out food...)

dialogues.speaker: Lyylikki
dialogues.text: Oh, you're back! Did you get the Lakkaberries?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I'll go gather some for you.

dialogues.speaker: Lyylikki
dialogues.text: Thank you for helping! Um... Once you bring the Lakkaberries back, I promise I'll make you the tastiest Feast of the Moon you've ever had!

dialogues.speaker: Lyylikki
dialogues.text: Oh, you're back! Did you get the Lakkaberries?
